name: JP
source:
Major: Computer Sciences

JP is the Engineering genius, often found getting his paws on whatever damaged electronic he can find, to fix and improve. Although skilled in software, hardware and electronic repairing, he’s usually suffering with one or another subject at University, due to the many side-jobs he has on his daily routine. His inseparable companion: his USB Drive.

[From [url=http://corruptpolygons.com/]Corrupt Polygons[/url]]
